commit 4bb05bfb7ed88288458ea833bc16581957044c4e
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 7 10:23:49 2026 +0000
Commit:     kaie@kuix.de <kaie@kuix.de>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 7 10:26:00 2026 +0000

    Bug 2048163 - Attempt to fix browser_oAuthGranularScopes.js by hardening the OAuth test window loading against the remoteness swap. r=darktrojan
    
    OAuth2TestUtils.promiseOAuthWindow() waited for the login window's browser with
    BrowserTestUtils.browserLoaded(), which hard-rejects ("window unloaded while we
    were waiting for the browser to load") on the transient content-window unload
    that a remoteness swap produces when the OAuth login page navigates to web
    content. Poll for the current browser to finish loading a real document instead,
    which tolerates the swap and benefits all promiseOAuthWindow callers.
    
    Additionally, browser_oAuthGranularScopes.js called expectOAuthDialog()
    fire-and-forget, turning that rejection into an uncaught rejection. Capture and
    await its promise, matching the coordinated pattern used by
    browser_verifyConfig.js, browser_oAuth2Window.js and browser_accountHubOAuth.js.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310621

diff --git a/mailnews/test/resources/OAuth2TestUtils.sys.mjs b/mailnews/test/resources/OAuth2TestUtils.sys.mjs
index fea55cf342e..239e099c612 100644
--- a/mailnews/test/resources/OAuth2TestUtils.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/test/resources/OAuth2TestUtils.sys.mjs
@@ -100,14 +100,20 @@ export const OAuth2TestUtils = {
         win.document.documentURI ==
         "chrome://messenger/content/browserRequest.xhtml"
     );
-    const oAuthBrowser = oAuthWindow.getBrowser();
-    if (
-      !oAuthBrowser.webProgress ||
-      oAuthBrowser.webProgress.isLoadingDocument ||
-      oAuthBrowser.currentURI.spec == "about:blank"
-    ) {
-      await BrowserTestUtils.browserLoaded(oAuthBrowser);
-    }
+    // Loading the OAuth login page navigates the window's browser to web
+    // content, which can trigger a remoteness swap. BrowserTestUtils.browserLoaded()
+    // hard-rejects ("window unloaded ...") on the transient unload that swap
+    // produces, so poll for the (current) browser to finish loading a real
+    // document instead.
+    await TestUtils.waitForCondition(() => {
+      const oAuthBrowser = oAuthWindow.getBrowser();
+      return (
+        oAuthBrowser?.currentURI &&
+        oAuthBrowser.currentURI.spec != "about:blank" &&
+        oAuthBrowser.webProgress &&
+        !oAuthBrowser.webProgress.isLoadingDocument
+      );
+    }, "the OAuth login page should finish loading");
     return oAuthWindow;
   },
title: Bug 2048163 - Attempt to fix browser_oAuthGranularScopes.js by hardening the OAuth test window loading against the remoteness swap. r=darktrojan
